recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Reopening this historical DataElement issue against current core would only be appropriate if OO decides to create a new ObservationDefinition-specific V2 mapping task.
issue_request: FHIR-5461 was a Published/Persuasive OO ballot comment for the DSTU1 DataElement resource asking the editors to review the new HL7 v2.8.2 OMC segment and add V2.x mappings where appropriate.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed commit was found for FHIR-5461. The relevant historical application appears to be commit cacb4626a33e26cbc231a2b66d1e53eb0ce31c4a, which added OMC.10, OMC.9, OMC.12, and OMC.11 mappings alongside existing OM1/OM3 mappings in the DataElement/ElementDefinition mapping spreadsheets.
additional_context: DataElement is no longer an active current-build resource: its source/fhir.ini resource, work group, and TLA entries are commented out, source/dataelement has no tracked files at HEAD, and source/history.html records DataElement as removed in R4. ElementDefinition remains active and normative in the current build, and source/elementdefinition-mappings.html presents the V2 OM1 mapping page as also related to ObservationDefinition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build has no active DataElement source to update, and the active successor mapping surface already carries the OMC fields that were appropriate to preserve.
